system.description: Starting at 14th level, a creature marked as your Primary Target has your intent bound to them, like a predator hunting its prey. When a marked creature would trigger an attack of opportunity, you make the attack at advantage. If you are using your Hunters Strike reaction, on a hit, the target must make a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu Save DC. On a failed save, they are knocked prone. If they were already prone and attempting to stand, they remain prone.
